description: Net unrealized profit/loss (NUPL) of a UTXO cohort as a share of that cohort's own market cap, derived from market-value-to-realized-value ratio (MVRV) as `1 - 1 / MVRV`. Positive values mean aggregate unrealized profit, negative values mean aggregate unrealized loss, and zero means spot equals the cohort's realized price. A zero or unavailable MVRV produces NaN. Uses all UTXOs. Unitless ratio in parts per million; 1,000,000 represents 1.0.
